* Load other texts that need a delay to overwrite everything else.
* Mordan8 - Initialize stock exchange. Not sure if this is placed correctly. Used to be in the old setup.Variables.xml
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Commented out StockExchange initializer and moved to Mayhem.GameCreator.SpawnStockExchange.
* We add a mutex here so that we call this script when the galaxy has been generated and the starting options are done.
* Otherwise, at the start of the game, we let Mayhem.GameCreator.SpawnStockExchange handle stock exchange initialization.
* Having the stock exchange initialized here is needed if the Stock Exchange task must later be modified.
* Reset station scripts if needed (no idea why very rarely some can stop).
* Update encyclopedia and equipment price at each new update.
